task: Make the flag "dark_mode" in Production match its Development configuration exactly (on/off state and value). Change nothing else.
finalText: DONE: `dark_mode` in Production is now on with value `grid`, matching Development. I changed only that flag's environment default. Its state was off with value `eu_west` before the change. Neither environment has segment or identity overrides for it.
